definitions.unmatched: No unmatched observed event onset within the next two seconds; includes late episodes.
definitions.late: Unmatched episode during an already-started sustained high-utilization event.
definitions.other_unmatched: Unmatched and not late; no claim that all such opportunities are fully independent.
definitions.rate_denominator: Duration-weighted rows with features and complete 3.75-second future support. This is discrete opportunity exposure, not continuous decision availability. Covered-source denominator is also reported unchanged.
definitions.margin_sensitivity: 0.5/1-second lead margins are descriptive offline timing sensitivities. They do not simulate admission, stale reads, route activation or prevented degradation.

limitations: Separate cohorts are not pooled. Adjacent rows are not independent repetitions.
Warnings use no-intervention prediction test only. Live rerouting traces are not relabeled.
Original future-support/cooldown matching retained; no model or trigger retuning.
